Maria: Quick thought — we need to finalize how cross-project ingest API keys work for analytics. Current options: shared org key vs project-scoped token + proxy. RFC asked for follow-up on tradeoffs.
Xiang: @Maria +1. Main concerns: least privilege for downstream consumers, telemetry attribution, and rotation. Org-shared keys are easier but make auditing & tenant separation messy.
Kyle: For dedicated ingestion endpoints we could accept project-scoped JWT with claim "ingest:write" scoped to project_id, then have the ingestion service attach org metadata after auth. That keeps keys short-lived and auditable.
Sam: How do we handle backfill jobs that need to write to multiple projects? Wildcard scopes vs a token that lists multiple projects — both have implications.
Maria: Prefer explicit multi-claim tokens (array of project ids) for internal scheduled backfills only. For customer-provided pipelines, require separate tokens per project.
security-bot: security-bot: Note: wildcard project scopes increase blast radius significantly. Recommend only explicit lists or an admin-approved delegation flow with extra audit hooks.
Xiang: Implementation challenge — lots of infra assumes a single "project" header. If tokens can contain multiple projects we need to change routing/telemetry to accept a project-list claim. That touches many services.
Kyle: Proposal: keep single-project tokens for the fast path. Add a "delegation API" for batch jobs where an admin can mint a short-lived multi-project token. That way runtime services don't need to change for standard pipelines.
Maria: Agreed. That reduces blast radius and keeps existing headers intact. Action items: (1) draft a mini-RFC for the delegation API pattern, (2) update ingestion to accept project-list claim if present but prefer single-project header, (3) ensure delegation tokens are capture-auditable and only issued via admin flows.
Sam: I'll mock the audit event schema and post it to #eng-sre. :thumbsup:
Xiang: One more thing — rotation/renewal semantics. Delegation tokens should be short TTL and non-renewable; any long-lived capability should be managed via an org-admin rotation flow. Confirm?
Maria: Confirmed. Delegation tokens: TTL <= 1h, no refresh; org-service-managed keys for long-lived pipelines with explicit approvals.
Maria: Let's sync tomorrow 10:00am to turn action items into issues. Thanks everyone!
thread_text: Quick follow-up on cross-project ingest key conventions — delegation API vs shared org keys, prefer delegation for batch/multi-project, single-project tokens for runtime, audit and TTL constraints.
